Projects

Remote Sensing

Mumbai: Satellite Composite Maps

I made colour composite maps of Mumbai from three satellites to see how land, water and plants look in different band combinations. In the NIR maps, healthy vegetation looks red. Click a map to see it bigger.

Data: Sentinel-2, LISS-3 (Bhoonidhi), Landsat 9 (USGS). Tools: ArcGIS, QGIS.

NDVI

Vegetation of Maharashtra Nature Park

NDVI shows how much green vegetation there is. I calculated it with this formula: (NIR - Red) / (NIR + Red), using Sentinel-2 data. In this map, NDVI goes from about 0.04 to 0.51. Darker green means more vegetation. The park looks greener than the area around it.

Data: Sentinel-2. Tool: QGIS.

Story Map

Quantifying Ecosystem Recovery

A story map about Maharashtra Nature Park in Mumbai. It is close to where I live in Dharavi. The area was not a forest before. It was turned into a man-made forest, and my story map looks at how it changed from 2011 to 2026.
